messages:
maria (sec): Heads-up: CVE-2026-3421 in OpenSSL 3.1.x — upstream pushed a patch this morning. Triage recommendation: backport to Dedicated + Private images ASAP. @devon can you run a quick impact scan on our private fleets?

devon (eng-infra): Running a quick scan now. Found openssl 3.1.2 in dedicated base image (dedicated-gpu-ubuntu-2026-03). On-prem appliance uses a musl-minimal image with openssl 3.0.x (not vulnerable), but several customer overlays vendor the lib.

rachel (eng-platform): Branch strategy discussion: propose creating hotfix branch off release/private-2026 -> hotfix/openssl-2026-3421. Build a bumped base image tag private-2026.3-hotfix and create customer-specific tags like cust-ABC-private-2026.3-hotfix.

noah (eng-sre): Air-gap note: on-prem customers that are air-gapped can’t pull new images. We’ll need to produce a signed tarball + manifest and provide instructions for manual install. Also think about image signing key — prod uses AWS KMS arn:aws:kms:.../redwood-image-signer which we can't expose.

sam (release): Testing plan: smoke + TLS handshake fuzzing + throughput regression on SUT for 1h. Canary in eu-west-1 dedicated pool for 2h then ramp. RBAC change required: short-lived permission to push hotfix tags to tiered registries (just-in-time token).

maria (sec): Also: compliance customers will need audit proof-of-patch. Add per-customer audit entry that includes image hash + signature + SEC ticket ref.

devon (eng-infra): Backport lanes: (1) rebuild base images with patched openssl, (2) for vendor-overlays, patch at overlay level and publish patched overlay images. Solutions eng must coordinate with customers who have overlays. I'll open PRs for both lanes.

rachel (eng-platform): RBAC proposal: create group 'sre-hotfix-ops' with scope images:tag:hotfix and time-limited grant (1 day). Implement via JIT tokens in Console and add audit webhook to SIEM. Will draft PR.

noah (eng-sre): KMS options for private: we already support customer-managed KMS via config "kms.provider: hsm|aws|azure". For offline signing, we have an existing flag 'signer.mode: offline' in onprem manifests but the path hasn't been exercised in 18 months — need to validate HSM signing and manifest verification flow.

devon (eng-infra): Important: customers running FIPS builds use openssl-fips 3.1.1-fips. Need vendor confirmation that FIPS builds include the patch; if not, escalate to vendor support.

maria (sec): Prioritization: CVSS 8.1, public exploit PoC observed in the wild. Recommend P0 for hosted + Dedicated pools. Private/on-prem default P1 but allow P0 for customers with exposed TLS endpoints or regulatory need.

sam (release): Can we automate cherry-picks? Our script 'scripts/cherry_backport.sh' can automerge into hotfix branches but needs manual QA gates. I'll run it once PR is green.

rachel (eng-platform): I'll open the RBAC PR and include the audit webhook change. Tagging @noah for KMS validation and @devon for image builds.

deploy-bot: Build queue: dedicated-gpu-ubuntu-2026-03-hotfix started (job 98765).

devon (eng-infra): Build failed on musl target: linker errors referencing libssl symbols. Investigating whether musl toolchain needs rebuild or if we can vendor patched .so into overlay.

maria (sec): If musl rebuild blocks the timeline, fallback: ship patched libssl as vendored .so in overlay for affected onprem customers and include shim loader + manifest verification.

sam (release): Tentative timeline: 8 hours for builds + CI, 12–24 hours for canary + rollout. I'll coordinate CSM customer notifications for private customers affected.

rachel (eng-platform): :thumbsup: PR opened for RBAC/JIT tokens, assigning reviewers from security and platform.

noah (eng-sre): Will validate offline KMS signing flow tomorrow and attach HSM logs to SEC ticket. Need an operator runbook for onprem handoff.

maria (sec): Created ticket SEC-2026-1123 and assigned to devon/sam/noah/rachel. Please upload build artifacts, container digests, and signatures to the ticket once available.

cve-bot: CVE-2026-3421 -> status: patched upstream. NVD: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-3421

maria (sec): Thanks all — keep updates in the SEC ticket. If anyone runs into blockers (musl build, FIPS vendors), escalate immediately and ping me.
